_comment: Manual ingredient-identity merges for the /pricing comparison. Maps one canonical key onto another so two differently-worded lines compare as the same ingredient. Key = sorted significant tokens of a description (see price_compare.canonical_key). Example: {"merge": {"chook": "chicken"}}. Added by a human when the auto-grouper under-merges. Only merge things that are genuinely the SAME ingredient in the same unit — never juice vs fresh, florets vs whole, or two sizes that carry a real price difference.
